attorneys.name: Daryl J. Wood
attorneys.practice_type: Driver License Restoration Lawyers in Waterford, MI
attorneys.bio:
More Than 26 Years Of Experience Restoring Driver's Licenses

I established my law practice, Daryl J. Wood and Associates, in 2015 to focus on license restoration and criminal defense work in Michigan. As a sole practitioner with more than 25+ years of experience helping clients preserve their driving privileges and defend against criminal charges, I have both the experience and flexibility to be a powerfully effective advocate for my clients. I don't take cases I know I can't win and will be straightforward with you about the situation you face.

Despite my depth of experience and no-nonsense style, I don't tell my clients what to do. Instead, I provide them with the information and perspective they need about the legal process and the laws in Michigan that will apply in their cases. I help my clients make informed and independent decisions that will serve them best in the long run, whether that involves making a plea deal, interpreting complex statutes, going to trial or pursuing an appeal.

I am a trusted resource to whom other Michigan attorneys turn for clarification about driver's license restoration. I have participated in many Driver's License Appeals Division (DLAD) and circuit court license restoration hearings statewide and have presented to Michigan's Institution of Continuing Legal Education (ICLE) and the State Bar of Michigan on the topic of license restoration.

I earned my law degree from Thomas M. Cooley Law School in 1996. I have also served as both a city councilman and mayor of Keego Harbor, Michigan. Give me a call to learn how I can help you preserve your license or defend against a criminal charge.

Preserve Your Freedom

If you're facing a criminal charge or stand to lose your license, you need the right information from a lawyer with experience to help you choose the next best step for you. I provide initial consultations for new clients. To schedule your appointment to discuss your situation, call or text my office in Plymouth at 248-318-3238 or email me, and we'll find a time to talk.

attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Rochester, MI
attorneys.bio:
Anna Wright graduated with honors from James Madison College within Michigan State University, with a Bachelor Degree in Political Theory, Constitutional Democracy and Social Relations in 2004. Additionally, Ms. Wright studied at the University of Cambridge (UK) as part of her Political Theory degree. In 2009, Anna graduated from Thomas M. Cooley Law School, where she served as editor of the law school’s Law Review. While in Law School, Ms. Wright focused on Trial Advocacy/Litigation practice as part of her specialty.

Ms. Wright is admitted to the practice of law in the State of Michigan, and the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan. She was previously employed as a claim litigation counsel for State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company, and Citizens Insurance Company. Ms. Wright’s insurance defense practice also included representing American Automobile Association (AAA) and Titan Insurance Company and their insureds. In 2017, Ms. Wright joined Atnip & Associates, PLLC.

Ms. Wright along with her husband and two young children reside in Rochester, Michigan. Ms. Wright spent her childhood in Europe where she traveled with her family and is fluent in Polish. Ms. Wright enjoys traveling, spending time with friends and relaxing by the water. She also adores her best friend Heather Atnip, who is also the proud Godmother to her youngest child Elise.

attorneys.name: Randolph M. Wright
attorneys.practice_type: Business and Corporate Law Lawyers in Birmingham, MI
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Wright is general counsel to numerous corporations both in the United States and abroad, advising senior management regarding general corporate affairs, regulatory compliance, finance, business planning, and the resolution of business disputes.

Mr. Wright is often called upon to negotiate complex business and legal issues, including the purchase or sale of a client company or its assets, and the resolution of contentious disputes between clients and suppliers, competitors, or government regulators. Mr. Wright frequently lectures to lawyers and business executives on the topics of international business transactions, enforcement of commercial agreements, and business financing.

Mr. Wright is a member of the American Bar Association and the State Bar of Michigan, and is admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court (1988). Also, he is a member of the Business Law and International Law Sections of both the ABA and Michigan bars. He is the past Chair of the International Law Section of the State Bar of Michigan.

Mr. Wright currently serves as a member of the Board of Directors-Emeritus of Search for Common Ground (formerly Chairman), a Washington, D.C., and Brussels, Belgium. based nonprofit organization committed to Track II diplomatic initiatives worldwide. It was Mr. Wright’s work with Search for Common Ground that led to the firm’s work in Russia, Ukraine, and the NIS. He participated in a multi-national, multi-cultural team of international lawyers representing thirty Russian companies during the privatization of Russian enterprises.

Mr. Wright is currently working with a team of lawyers and business colleagues on a plan to assist with reconstruction efforts in Ukraine after the Russia-Ukraine War.

attorneys.name: Edward J. Zelmanski
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Plymouth, MI
attorneys.bio:
Edward J. Zelmanski is a partner with the firm Zelmanski, Danner & Fioritto, PLLC. After graduating from the University of Michigan in 1976, he earned his Juris Doctorate from the University of Detroit School of Law and has been a member of the Michigan Bar since 1979. He is a Michigan Master Lawyer and a member of the Real Estate Section of the Michigan Bar Association.

Mr. Zelmanski has a broad range of experience in real estate and community association matters, including the review,interpretation, enforcement and amendment of community association governing documents, as well as providing counseling and problem solving for community association boards and members. Mr. Zelmanski has experience with state and federal real estate litigation, foreclosure proceedings, real estate title and boundary disputes, as well as disputes with real estate developers and contractors. He has defended community associations in civil rights disputes and has assisted community associations and individual clients with civil rights disputes, bankruptcies, probate matters and class actions. He has contributed to the amendment of the Michigan Condominium Act, has published materials on real estate subjects and has lectured on real estate topics at Wayne State University and the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law. He has trained dozens of attorneys in law school clinics. Mr. Zelmanski has also presented lectures on community association topics for the Real Property Section of the Michigan State Bar, Community Association Institute, United Condominium Owners of Michigan, Lorman Education Services and for private community management classes. He currently serves on the Board of Directors for the Michigan Chapter of the Community Association Institute and currently serves as Board President.

Mr. Zelmanski joined the Firm in 1997. He has also provided pro bono services to the elderly, church groups, and the Veterans of Foreign Wars. He enjoys spending time with his family and has a myriad of other outside interests, including music, literature, cross-cultural studies, hiking, and swimming, and sheet metal and carpentry projects in addition to being an avid baseball and football fan.

He has contributed to the amendment of the Michigan Condominium Act, has published materials on real estate subjects and has lectured on real estate topics at Wayne State University and the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law. He has trained dozens of attorneys in law school clinics. Mr. Zelmanski has also presented lectures on community association topics for the Real Property Section of the Michigan State Bar, Community Association Institute, United Condominium Owners of Michigan, Lorman Education Services and for private community management classes. He currently serves on the Board of Directors for the Michigan Chapter of the Community Association Institute and currently serves as Board President.

Mr. Zelmanski joined the Firm in 1997. He has also provided pro bono services to the elderly, church groups, and the Veterans of Foreign Wars. He enjoys spending time with his family and has a myriad of other outside interests, including music, literature, cross-cultural studies, hiking, and swimming, and sheet metal and carpentry projects in addition to being an avid baseball and football fan.

attorneys.bio:
Attorney Zinn advises clients ranging from start-ups to multi-national corporations. Attorney Zinn is well versed in transaction structures and the ensuing tax implications. Attorney Zinn has also served as General Counsel for companies in the pharmaceutical industry.

At KPMG's Washington National Tax M&A practice, she advised on sophisticated acquisitions, tax-free reorganizations, cross-border transactions, shareholder issues and corporate restructuring. Additionally, Attorney Zinn served as the Chief Operating Officer of KPMG's Global M&A Tax practice. Locally, Zinn held positions with Kellogg Company and her former law firm, Miller Canfield.

Zinn received her LL.M. in Taxation from Georgetown University Law Center and her J.D. from Vermont Law School. She also studied at the University of Exeter in England. She received her B.A. from Western Michigan University and is admitted to the District of Columbia Bar and to the Michigan Bar.
